audit.whatIsWrong: All Out is named 15 times and never given a cooldown; dosFull[2].d invents "the fifteen-second invitation" for it. All Out is 120/100/80s. Path Maker's 14/13/12/11/10s and Ntofo Strikes' 3.5s / 450 range are absent, though the page's whole plan depends on them.
audit.why: A baited All Out at rank 1 buys two minutes, not fifteen seconds — that is the difference between one trade and owning the lane phase. And Ntofo Strikes sits at exactly 450 range, the same as Blooming Blows, so "poke at your Q range" means standing in his.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry 120s at rank 1; phases[3].why carries Path Maker's 14s. The mirror wrote the reciprocal numbers from his side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is missing: Blooming Blows' outer edge deals TRUE damage, and All Out explicitly strips K'Sante's own defenses. The page never says either, so it reads as though his tank stats simply soak the burn.
audit.why: It is the reason this lane is playable into the tankiest top laner in the game — the part of your poke that matters was never taxed by his armour, and his own ultimate makes the rest of your damage land harder too. The mirror flagged the same omission as its most important addition.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t and breakdown.cooldowns now state the true-damage edge and that All Out strips his resists.
